The Analyst, Research Computing Systems supports researchers using large-scale computing and storage infrastructure at SFU and at Canadian Digital Research Infrastructure facilities. The role provides application support and assists with configurations and implementations of research computing systems. Master's degree in science or computing plus 3+ years deploying complex research software. Expertise in automation tools (Puppet, Ansible, Terraform), OS deployment, container orchestration, Kubernetes.
